name: IBANforge
description: Check the bank behind an IBAN before you pay: validation in 89 countries, a bank-code verdict from the national register (DE, AT, BE, SK, BG, CH, LI), the bank and BIC with their source, SEPA and VoP readiness from the EPC registers where they list the bank, and bank-level sanctions (OFAC, EU, UN). It does not check the payee's name. BIC directory, 121k+ entries (entries, not institutions): GLEIF and national registers, refreshed monthly, plus a public copy of the SWIFT directory frozen in January 2018 that still makes up about two thirds of the rows. Also Swiss clearing (1,100+ SIX BankMaster entries). MCP-native, prepaid packs by card or x402 micropayments on Base L2, and a free API key that needs no e-mail.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validate a single IBAN with the bank-code verdict, BIC with its source, SEPA, issuer, and risk data ($0.005)

tools.name: batch_validate_iban
tools.description: Validate up to 100 IBANs in one call ($0.002 USDC each via x402; one credit per IBAN on a key)

tools.name: lookup_bic
tools.description: Look up a BIC/SWIFT code against 121k+ BIC entries (39k+ LEI-enriched via GLEIF) ($0.003)

tools.name: check_compliance
tools.description: Bank-level triage: sanctions lists (OFAC, EU, UN) matched on the payee's bank (BIC8), the country against a fixed list of sanctioned jurisdictions, never the payee's name + FATF + SEPA reachability + VoP readiness + risk score ($0.02)

tools.name: lookup_ch_clearing
tools.description: Look up a Swiss BC-Nummer / IID with full payment-rail participation (SIC, euroSIC, CHF instant), QR-IID and institution type — 1,100+ entries from SIX BankMaster ($0.003)

tools.name: validate_payment_reference
tools.description: Validate a structured payment reference — RF/ISO 11649, Swiss QRR, Belgian OGM/VCS, Finnish viitenumero — with the QRR↔QR-IBAN pairing verdict when an IBAN is supplied (free)

tools.name: check_postal_address
tools.description: Check a structured ISO 20022 postal address against SPS (SIX), HVPS+/T2 or Fedwire rules ahead of the November 2026 changes — every finding cites its source document (free)
